articles.title_zh: 关于匿名对大语言模型性能的影响
articles.content_zh: 由于大型语言模型越来越多地部署在敏感领域,匿名输入数据以保护个人可识别的信息已成为一项关键的做法。 然而,这种无名化对模型效用的影响并没有得到很好的理解。 本文对隐私与业绩之间的权衡进行了系统的经验性研究。 我们评价了11个不同基准的5个显著语言模型,将其业绩与原始输入和假名比较。 我们的结果显示,虽然匿名一般会降低性能,但效果却非常细微。 我们发现,更有能力的模型,如Quen2.5-72B和GPT-4o迷你模型,其性能下降幅度最大,这表明对具体实体信息的依赖程度更高. 其影响也取决于任务:对TrealfulQA的性能随着匿名化而改善,而RGB等注重检索的任务则经历灾难性的衰退. 进一步的实验表明,保留实体独特性的可逆匿名技术大大超过编辑等不可逆转的技术,明确推动关于匿名的模型没有明显的好处。 我们的结论是,匿名不是一个一刀切的解决办法,必须与模式和任务共同设计,以便有效地平衡隐私和效用。 我们的调查结果为发展更强大、更了解隐私的人工智能系统提供了关键基准。

articles.title: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Benchmarks: Arabic Textual Entailment and Natural Inference Datasets
articles.content: Natural Language Inference processes pairs of sentences to extract their semantic relations. NLI has been a hot research topic, integrated as a main component in other NLP applications. Despite significant advancements in textual inference across various languages all around the world, Arabic language still suffers from limited resources in this domain. To address this gap, this paper introduces E-CONAN benchmarks that are composed of sentences pairs from various sources: (1) automatically-translated pairs, (2) human-validated machine-translated pairs, (3) hand-crafted pairs from teaching Arabic as foreign language books, and (4) headlines pairs from different news channels containing rumors. E-CONAN contains two benchmark datasets, E-CONAN-2, a 2-way dataset (RTE) and E-CONAN-3, a 3-way dataset (NLI). Additionally, we have used E-CONAN benchmarks to evaluate 9 state-of-the-art multilingual pretrained models using zero-shot classification. Models were evaluated across the ArNLI, XNLI, and E-CONAN datasets. Results show that E-CONAN is a potentially valuable resource for evaluating model generalization and even for fine-tuning pre-trained models. Its diverse composition, derived from a combination of sources, offers a broader and more robust assessment compared to XNLI and ArNLI. In addition, we have evaluated 5 LLMs on E-CONAN-3 dataset. Moreover, we incorporated MARBERT as a representative Arabic-specific baseline and conducted performance evaluation comparison to demonstrate how Arabic-specific models scale against cross-lingual and LLM-based approaches on the E-CONAN benchmarks. Furthermore, we conducted detailed qualitative and quantitative error analysis to analyze frequent error patterns. E-CONAN benchmarks will be publicly available, we hope that it will enrich research community in Arabic textual entailment and natural language inference.

articles.title_zh: e-CONAN(配制、连接和中立) 基准:阿拉伯文文本细节和自然推论数据集
articles.content_zh: 自然语言推论处理对句以提取其语义关系. NLI一直是一个热门的研究课题,作为主要组成部分融入其他NLP应用中. 尽管世界各地各种语言在文字推论方面取得了显著进展,但阿拉伯语在这方面的资源有限。 为了弥补这一差距,本文介绍了由各种来源的句子组成的E-CONAN基准:(1) 自动翻译对;(2) 人机翻译对;(3) 作为外语书籍教授阿拉伯语的手工制作对;以及(4) 不同新闻频道含有谣言的头条对。 E-CONAN包含两个基准数据集,即E-CONAN-2,一个2路数据集(RTE)和E-CONAN-3,一个3路数据集(NLI). 此外,我们还采用电子CONAN基准,采用零镜头分类法评价9种最新多语种预训模式。 整个ArNLI、XNLI和E-CONAN数据集对模型进行了评价。 结果显示,E-CONAN是评价模型泛化,甚至微调预培训模型的潜在宝贵资源. 与XNLI和ArnLI相比,其不同组成来源的组合提供了更广泛和更强有力的评估。 此外,我们还评价了E-CONAN-3数据集上的5个LLM。 此外,我们把MARBERT作为具有代表性的阿拉伯特定基准,并进行了绩效评价比较,以显示在电子CONAN基准上,阿拉伯特定模型如何比照跨语言和基于LLM的方法来衡量。 此外,我们进行了详细的定性和定量错误分析,以分析频繁的错误模式。 e-CONAN基准将公开提供,我们希望它将丰富阿拉伯文文本和自然语言推断的研究界。

articles.title: The Semantic Elevation Operator and the Closure of the Undecidable Class under Preservation
articles.content: The undecidability of a program's static semantic properties is governed by Rice's theorem. Self-modifying systems, however, require analysing not whether a property holds now, but whether it is preserved when the system rewrites itself. We formalise this transition through a semantic elevation operator ΛΦ, which turns the static question "does x satisfy P?" into the dynamic question "is P preserved after x is transformed by Φ?". We prove that when Φ is intensional (depending on the source code, not only on the computed function), the elevated property remains undecidable even though it breaks the extensionality that Rice's theorem requires; the proof rests on Kleene's recursion theorem, not on Rice. Consequently the class U of non-verifiable properties is closed under the elevation operator. Unbounded iteration of the operator climbs the arithmetical hierarchy -to Π02-completeness- consolidating non-verifiability as a structural fact. We further show that the supervisory regress does not terminate: no fnite tower of increasingly capable verifiers yields an unconditional certificate. A categorical reading of these results in the efective topos, in which elevation appears as an instance of Lawvere's fxed-point theorem, is left as a direction for future work.

articles.title_zh: 语义升降操作员和被保存的不可辨认类的关闭
articles.content_zh: 一个程序的静态语义属性的不可解性受赖斯定理的支配. 然而,自我修改系统需要分析的不是某一财产是否现在持有,而是当系统自我改写时是否保存下来。 将静态问题“x满足P吗? ” 变成动态问题“x被x转换后P是否保留下来?” 我们证明,当 QQ 被加固( 取决于源代码, 不仅仅是计算函数) 时, 提升的属性仍然不可计量, 即使它打破了 Rice 定理所要求的延伸性; 证明基于 Kleene 的递归定理, 而不是 Rice 。 因此,不可核证财产的U级在高程操作器下关闭。 操作员的无限制迭代爬升了算术的等级-到~~02-完成-巩固非可核查性作为一个结构事实. 我们进一步表明,监督退步并没有终止:任何能力日益增强的核查员的尖塔都无法出具无条件的证书。 对这些结果的断然解读,即作为Lawvere的fxed-point定理实例出现的海拔水平是未来工作的方向。

articles.title: MultiHuSE: A Multimodal Dataset for Humour Styles and Emotions
articles.content: Computational recognition of verbal humour remains a challenging task, requiring an understanding of language, delivery style, emotions, and cultural context. Most existing approaches focus on binary classification and lack datasets that capture psychological dimensions of humour alongside variations in expression. We introduce MultiHuSE, a multimodal dataset comprising 2,407 high-definition videos of 50 demographically diverse actors performing 1,463 text samples across four psychological humour styles (affiliative, aggressive, self-enhancing, and self-deprecating), as well as neutral content. A subset is additionally annotated for underlying emotions. The dataset uniquely captures multiple actor interpretations of the same texts, enabling systematic analysis of expressive diversity. Baseline experiments show that multimodal fusion outperforms unimodal approaches (80.1% vs. 77.4% accuracy) in humour style classification, with particularly strong gains for affiliative humour (66% to 74%). While text provides the strongest individual signal, fusion models deliver meaningful improvements. We hope that MultiHuSE provides empirical support for psychological theories linking humour and emotion, while also opening new avenues for research in human communication, well-being, and AI-driven interaction. The dataset is available for academic use under an End-User Licence Agreement.

articles.title_zh: MultiHUSE: 幽默风格和情感的多式数据集
articles.content_zh: 口头幽默的计算承认仍然是一个具有挑战性的任务,需要理解语言、表达风格、情感和文化背景。 大多数现有方法都注重二进制分类,缺乏能够将幽默的心理层面与表达的变异结合起来的数据集。 我们引入了MultiHUSE, 由50个不同人口结构的行动者的2,407个高清晰度视频组成的多模式数据集, 一个子集被附加附加说明 深层情感。 数据集独有地捕捉了多个行为体对相同文本的解释,从而能够对表达多样性进行系统分析. 基线实验表明,在幽默风格分类中,多式聚变的优于单式方法(80.1%对77.4%的准确性),在从属幽默(66%至74%)方面尤其大有收获。 文本提供了最强的单个信号,而聚变模型提供了有意义的改进. 我们希望MultiHUSE为将幽默和情感联系在一起的心理理论提供经验性支持,同时也为人类交流,福祉和AI驱动的互动研究开辟了新的途径. 根据最终用户许可证协议,数据集可供学术界使用。

articles.title: Automatic Lyric Transcription for Greek Songs: Scaling and Task Composition Effects in Whisper Adaptation
articles.content: Automatic Lyric Transcription (ALT) remains substantially more challenging than speech recognition due to melodic variability, rhythmic irregularity, and accompaniment interference. This is heightened in low-resource languages like Greek, where no prior benchmark for ALT exists. We present the first controlled study of Whisper adaptation for Greek ALT, investigating model scaling effects, task composition via multitask training in transcribe-translate ratios, and two-stage speech-to-singing adaptation. We also curate a segment-level aligned singing dataset based on the Greek Audio Dataset (GAD) using source separation and CTC forced alignment. Results show that scaling consistently improves performance, while multitask learning acts as a beneficial regularizer primarily for smaller-capacity models. The 2-stage adaptation in Whisper Large-v3 achieves a Word Error Rate (WER) of 27.2%, a significant improvement over zero-shot baselines, establishing the first Greek ALT benchmark.

articles.title_zh: 希腊歌曲的自动拼写转写:在低调适应中的缩放和任务组成效果
articles.content_zh: 由于流体变异,节奏不规则,以及伴奏干扰,自动语言转写(ALT)仍然比语音识别更具挑战性. 这一点在希腊语等低资源语言中得到了加强,因为希腊语没有先前的ALT基准. 我们介绍了对希腊低音调的Whisper适应的第一次控制研究,调查模型缩放效应,通过转录-转录比率的多任务培训进行任务构成,以及两阶段的语音对唱适应. 我们还根据希腊音频数据集(GAD),利用源码分离和CTC强制对齐,管理一个段级对齐的歌唱数据集. 结果显示,规模化能不断提高绩效,而多任务学习主要对能力较小的模型起到有益的调节作用。 Whisper Large-v3的2级改版实现了27.2%的WER错误率(WER),比零镜头基线有了显著改善,建立了第一个希腊ALT基准.
